scholarships.title: Nazarbayev University Financial Aid and Scholarships for International Applicants — Foundation Year and Undergraduate programmes (2027–2028 cycle)
scholarships.official_source: Nazarbayev University (NU), Office of the Registrar / International Admissions, Astana, Kazakhstan

eligibility: Hold an admission offer from Nazarbayev University and click 'Submit Financial Support Application' in the Personal Account

Select one published category: NUET Applicants, SAT/ACT Applicants, Winners of International and/or Republican Subject Olympiads, IB Diploma Holders, A-Level/NIS Grade 12 Certificate Holders, or NUFYP Students
Meet the minimum academic result for the selected category, or the application is not considered
NUET: minimum total score of 120 with at least 50 in each of Mathematics and Critical Thinking and Problem Solving (NUET fee 7,000 KZT)

SAT/ACT for international applicants: Digital SAT 1140 or ACT 24 for the Foundation Year; Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26 for undergraduate programmes; tests must be taken in person and results valid to 1 August 2027
IB Diploma: total score 30 with 4, 4 and 5 in three Higher Level subjects
A-Level/NIS Grade 12: not less than ABB in any three subjects, using only final certificates issued in 2025 and 2026

Olympiad winners: gold or silver (I or II place) in the last year for the Republican Olympiad, or gold, silver or bronze in the last three years for the International Olympiad; an interview is required
English proficiency: IELTS 6.0 overall for undergraduate programmes (writing 6.0, reading, listening and speaking 5.5) or IELTS 5.5 for the Foundation Year programme, or an equivalent TOEFL score
existing.eligibility_summary: Applicants must first hold an admission offer from Nazarbayev University and then apply separately for financial support in their Personal Account, choosing one of six published categories. International applicants may qualify under the SAT/ACT category (Digital SAT 1140 or ACT 24 for the Foundation Year, Digital SAT 1240 or ACT 26 for undergraduate programmes, taken in person, valid to 1 August 2027), or as an IB Diploma holder (30 total with 4, 4, 5 in three Higher Level subjects), an A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificate holder (not less than ABB in three subjects), or a winner of an International or Republican Subject Olympiad. English is required at IELTS 6.0 for undergraduate and IELTS 5.5 for the Foundation Year programme.
benefits: Tuition fee for the Foundation Year Program or undergraduate programme
Monthly stipend (published as part of the Abai Scholarship component)
Medical insurance (published as part of the Abai Scholarship component)
coverage: Tuition fee for the Foundation Year Program or undergraduate programme
Monthly stipend (published as part of the Abai Scholarship component)
Medical insurance (published as part of the Abai Scholarship component)
requirements: A current Nazarbayev University admission offer
Category minimum requirements as published on the official Financial Aid and Scholarships page
In-person IELTS/TOEFL with the official electronic result sent through the Testing Center, plus a scanned copy uploaded to the Personal Account (IELTS institution code NU, TOEFL iBT code 6762)
Payment of the NUET fee within the deadline if the NUET category is selected
Documents confirming the result for the selected category
documents: Scanned copy of the IELTS or TOEFL certificate (electronic results must be sent through the Testing Center)
Official electronic SAT or ACT results sent by the College Board, plus a scanned copy of the certificate
IB Diploma results or final A-Level/NIS Grade 12 certificates, as applicable
Olympiad results documentation, if applying under the Olympiad category
NUET result, if applying under the NUET category
existing.english_requirement: Required. IELTS 6.0 overall with writing 6.0 and reading, listening and speaking 5.5 for undergraduate programmes; IELTS 5.5 overall with writing and reading 5.5 and speaking and listening 5.0 for the Foundation Year Program; or the equivalent TOEFL score. IELTS and TOEFL must be taken in person at a test centre — IELTS Online, TOEFL iBT Home Edition and TOEFL PDT are not accepted. Test results are valid only if they do not expire before 1 August 2027.
application_method: Apply for admission and receive an admission offer through admissions.nu.edu.kz
In the Personal Account, click 'Submit Financial Support Application' and complete the form in the Admission Results section
Select the category under which the application will be considered and upload the documents confirming the result for that category
Submit the application; once submitted, the form and uploaded documents cannot be changed
Check the email inbox including Spam for the Admissions Office notification and any correction deadline
existing.selection_notes: Application for financial support is considered only if the applicant meets the minimum requirements for the selected category; otherwise the application is not considered. For SAT/ACT and IB/A-Level categories, certificates are considered without superscoring, and NUET test results have no appeal procedure. The university's published regular-admission process assesses eligibility through document upload and shortlisting, with interviews and final notification by email.
existing.notes: Funding is separate from admission: an applicant must first secure an admission offer and can then submit a financial support application. Only one financial support application may be submitted per person. Accepting a regular admission offer and paying the guarantee fee means the application for financial support will not be considered.
existing.duration: One-year Nazarbayev University Foundation Year Program (NUFYP) or a four-year undergraduate bachelor degree programme
existing.application_period: The official Financial Aid and Scholarships page publishes the financial support application deadline for the 2027–2028 cycle as 'October 2026 – To be announced later' for all categories, including NUET Applicants and international applicants applying under the SAT/ACT category.
existing.deadline_display: Financial support application deadline published as October 2026, exact dates to be announced later; the linked regular-admission application window for the 2026–2027 mid-year intake is 18 August – 28 November 2026
